text: GAO found more than 1,700 former DoD acquisition officials, general officers and other senior employees had moved to major contractors: 1,718 people hired after 2016 by the 14 contractors it reviewed, with the most at Raytheon (315 as of 2019). About 37,000 people at those firms had left DoD civilian or military service in the prior five years (as reported by Military.com; GAO's own report not read here)

GAO-08-485 studied 2,435 former DoD officials hired by contractors in 2004 to 2006; about 65 percent went to seven contractors, and at least 422 of the jobs could have involved work under the former official's own agency, office or command (as summarized by POGO)
Patrick Shanahan, who became Deputy Secretary and later acting Secretary of Defense, came from roughly 30 years at Boeing and recused himself from Boeing matters (reported)
Mark Esper, nominated as Secretary of Defense, had worked as a Raytheon lobbyist from 2010 to 2017; he declined a senator's request to extend his Raytheon recusal for his whole tenure (reported)

James Mattis, Secretary of Defense from 2017, had served on the board of General Dynamics after retiring from the military and needed a waiver of the seven-year rule for recently retired officers (reported)
